description.en: Check for outdated packages and security vulnerabilities

instructions: Pruefe Abhaengigkeiten auf Updates und Sicherheitsluecken. Variablen: project_path, package_manager (npm/mvn/gradle).

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "{{ project_path }}"
PM="{{ package_manager }}"
echo "=== Outdated Dependencies ==="
if [ "$PM" = "npm" ]; then
  npm outdated 2>&1 || true
elif [ "$PM" = "mvn" ]; then
  mvn -q versions:display-dependency-updates 2>&1 || true
elif [ "$PM" = "gradle" ]; then
  ./gradlew dependencyUpdates 2>&1 || true
else
  echo "Unsupported package manager: $PM" && exit 1
fi

set -euo pipefail
cd "{{ project_path }}"
PM="{{ package_manager }}"
echo "=== Security Audit ==="
if [ "$PM" = "npm" ]; then
  npm audit 2>&1 || true
elif [ "$PM" = "mvn" ]; then
  mvn -q dependency:tree 2>&1 | head -100 || true
  echo "(Run OWASP dependency-check for full security audit)"
elif [ "$PM" = "gradle" ]; then
  ./gradlew dependencies 2>&1 | head -100 || true
fi

config.condition: cd "{{ project_path }}" && PM="{{ package_manager }}"; if [ "$PM" = "npm" ]; then npm audit --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); sys.exit(0 if d.get('metadata',{}).get('vulnerabilities',{}).get('critical',0)>0 else 1)" 2>/dev/null; else exit 1; fi
config.then_command: echo "CRITICAL vulnerabilities found! Immediate action required."

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "{{ project_path }}"
PM="{{ package_manager }}"
echo "# Dependency Update Report"
echo "Generated: $(date -Iseconds)"
echo "Project: {{ project_path }}"
echo "Package Manager: $PM"
echo ""
echo "## Outdated Dependencies"
if [ "$PM" = "npm" ]; then
  npm outdated 2>&1 || true
fi
echo ""
echo "## Security Summary"
if [ "$PM" = "npm" ]; then
  npm audit --omit=dev 2>&1 || true
fi
